core_memory.customer_profile: Michael, 35, Seattle. Freelance graphic designer, works from home often. Values design aesthetic and seamless integration of gadgets/appliances; prefers sleek, modern, stainless-steel finishes. New customer(first interaction). Big coffee lover. Referred by a friend who praised our support.
core_memory.coffee_machine_interest: DECIDED: Espresso machine w/ steam wand(for lattes/cappuccinos, hosting). Wants sleek stainless-steel finish. Concerns: brew temp(wants adjustable/hot), footprint(38 sq ft counter, may move toaster oven), cleaning, warranty.
core_memory.purchase_readiness: First-time online buyer, anxious about coupon fields; wants New Customer Discount confirmed before finalizing. Considering accessories to hit free-shipping threshold. Open to expedited fee for end-of-month event. Tracks shipments closely; cautious about returns.

archival_memory.michael_pricing_promos: Asked about espresso machine price range; interested in New Customer Discount(saw it on homepage but didn't click in time), bundle deals, and limited-time promos.
archival_memory.michael_shipping: Seattle delivery. Asked whether we ship from local warehouse or out of state, and expected timeframes. Wants product before a small family gathering he's hosting later this month(time-sensitive).
archival_memory.michael_referral_priorities: Referred by a friend who bought a kitchen appliance(air fryer or blender) and praised our customer support. Big coffee lover. Wants machine to match routine exactly: brew frequency/capacity, cleaning complexity, counter footprint.
archival_memory.michael_counter_space: Kitchen not tiny but counter crowded with appliances(toaster oven, spice rack). Willing to rearrange but wants espresso machine dimensions before buying to plan footprint.
archival_memory.michael_warranty_concern: Asked about warranties/quality guarantee. Past bad experiences with other brands offering short warranties and painful service. Hopes policy is accommodating, especially for higher-end models.
archival_memory.michael_brew_temperature_concern: Has had drip coffee makers that don't get hot enough, forcing him to microwave coffee(dislikes this). Wants adjustable temperature settings or reliably hot coffee. Temperature is make-or-break for his at-home coffee experience.
